text:
🚨 Russia claims it destroyed a cargo ship in the Black Sea.

According to the claim, the vessel was carrying weapons and military equipment for Ukraine. There is no independent confirmation yet.

Netanyahu sounds the alarm on Iran:

"In the very near future, we will face international pressure to accept a nuclear Iran."

Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei calls the US response "deceptive." Tehran sent its seven conditions and the first US reply fell short, he says.

He called US claims of talks and a Qatar meeting pure lies, and denied any planned meeting with JD Vance.

🚨 UKMTO warning 201/26: a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, at 1338 UTC today.

The crew are safe and there is no environmental impact. Ships are urged to transit with caution.

https://t.co/2mK7jQTjw1

Trump says Israel and the Gulf states shielded by US forces in the Iran war will pay back every dollar it cost, naming Israel for the first time.

Gulf governments say they were never told of Washington's plans and took the brunt of Iran's retaliation.

https://t.co/OxyHwSP7eU

Iranian Artesh and IRGC officers have been running military training for "Janfada" volunteer units.

The units trained with Dehlavieh anti tank guided missiles, FPV drones, MASAF 2 rifles and a rare US made M4A1 carbine fitted with an M203 grenade launcher. https://t.co/0u32kT0RTa

🚨 ADNOC Logistics and Services confirms one of its vessels was damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters in the Arabian Gulf this afternoon.

Response efforts are ongoing, and the company says more updates will follow. https://t.co/s9l7PF8wRU
Canada has reimposed sanctions on 11 Iranian entities, accusing them of contributing to Tehran's nuclear activities.

Likud MK Elisha Medan, who lost both legs in a Gaza tunnel blast three years ago to the day, stood on prosthetic legs to be sworn in at the 26th Knesset.

Fellow lawmakers applauded him. https://t.co/edaKZ0Axro

Iraq turned away a plane carrying Iran's national football team from Basra airport, citing the risk of breaching US sanctions on Iranian airlines.

The flight went back to Abadan and the squad will now travel to Basra by road for a regional tournament.

Houthi fighters hit Saudi backed PLC forces in Al Jawf with Shawaz fiber optic FPV kamikaze drones, new footage shows.

The drones carried PG 7 type anti tank HEAT warheads, some improvised, rigged with commercial limit switches to set them off. https://t.co/x8JAJoIpcd

The Houthis warned companies and investors to pull their money out of Saudi Arabia and move it to safer countries.

They say the kingdom will stay unsafe for investment until it ends its military campaign and lifts the blockade on Yemen.

🚨 The Houthis claim four strikes on Saudi Arabia: King Khalid Airport and East West pipeline pumping stations in Riyadh, Aramco in Abqaiq, Saudi backed forces in Al Madaribah and Riyadh's financial district.

They deny hitting the pipeline near Medina.

France has summoned Iran's ambassador over a cyber attack it blames on the IRGC that hit fridges in more than 700 supermarkets.

Paris calls it the first large scale sabotage of its kind on French soil, vows a proportionate response and will seek EU sanctions.

Rubio mounted a forceful defense of Pete Hegseth as Democrats push impeachment.

He said Hegseth carried out a direct order from the commander in chief and did it "quite effectively" on every front.

Rubio says the US no longer needs major combat operations against Iran because the blockade and sanctions are wrecking its economy.

"It's not a stalemate. They're bleeding," he said, adding the US military stands ready if Tehran crosses red lines. https://t.co/sOLq7of9iE

Iran's top general Ali Abdollahi and IRGC Aerospace chief Majid Mousavi toured a newly unveiled underground "missile city."
Footage shows it packed with Fattah 1 ballistic missiles, and a new stealthy long range cruise missile was spotted too.

Egypt's Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty says Egyptian troops have been in Saudi Arabia for months, deployed after Iran tensions and attacks on the kingdom.
He called Egypt's role strictly defensive and said Cairo wants a political solution.

Pete Hegseth hit back hard at the impeachment push, saying Democrats impeached Trump twice and failed both times.
"They will fail again," he said, vowing to stand with Trump every day. Trump then graded his defense an "A" PLUS, PLUS, PLUS.

Rubio says Iran is demanding war reparations and "this is not going to happen."
He added that Tehran would love a deal, but its current conditions are absurd and the two sides are not even close. The US stands ready to negotiate if a deal can be done.
